description: This file defines an employee repository that encapsulates database operations related to Employee objects using SQLAlchemy. It includes functions for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employees, with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeEmailAlreadyExistsError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when an employee email violates the uniqueness constraint.

classes.name: InvalidSortError
classes.description: Custom exception for invalid sort parameters.

methods.name: Select _apply_filters( stmt: Select, search: Optional[str], department: Optional[str], status: Optional[EmployeeStatus], )
methods.description: Applies search, department, and status filters to a SQLAlchemy Select statement.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Employee],int] list_employees( db: Session, page: int, size: int, search: Optional[str] = None, department: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[EmployeeStatus] = None, sort: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a page of employee records with total count based on filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Employee] get_employee(db: Session, employee_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee by ID.

methods.name: Employee create_employee(db: Session, data: dict)
methods.description: Creates a new employee record, raising an error if email is not unique.

methods.name: Employee update_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee, data: dict)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing employee, raising an error if email uniqueness is violated.

methods.name: None delete_employee(db: Session, employee: Employee)
methods.description: Deletes an employee record from the database.
